subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Callous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Tender**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Callous"** means showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. (निर्दयी, कठोर)

 
 
• **Example:** His callous comments about the tragedy shocked everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Tender"** refers to being gentle, kind, and sensitive. It is the exact opposite of being callous. (कोमल, दयालु)
 
 
• **Example:** She gave him a tender smile filled with compassion and care.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Callous'** is **'Tender'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Tender**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Augment **(बढ़ाना): To make something greater by adding to it; to increase.

 
 
• **Example:** She augmented her income by taking on freelance work.
 
 
 
• **Desolate **(उजाड़): A place that is empty and without people, making it feel sad or lonely.
 
 
• **Example:** The once-thriving town now looked desolate and abandoned.
 
 
 
• **Beguile **(मोह लेना): To charm or enchant someone, sometimes in a deceptive way.
 
 
• **Example:** The salesperson tried to beguile customers with attractive offers.
